CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayToList

Joins the elements of a one-dimensional array into a single string, with a delimiter between the elements.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayToList(array [, delimiter ])

Parameters

array
A one-dimensional array of simple values.
delimiter
String to put between elements. The default is a comma. The whole string is used, so ", " gives a comma followed by a space.

Returns

The list as a string.

Usage

Every element must be a simple value; an element that is itself an array or structure throws an error (so ArrayToList does not work on a two-dimensional array, but it does on one of its rows). Empty elements produce empty list positions. The opposite function is ListToArray.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Colors = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Colors[1] = "Red">
<CFSET Colors[2] = "Green">
<CFSET Colors[3] = "Blue">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>ArrayToList(Colors)</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Colors)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ArrayToList(Colors, " + ")</TD><TD>#ArrayToList(Colors, " + ")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ListLen of the result</TD><TD>#ListLen(ArrayToList(Colors))#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ListToArray, ValueList, StructKeyList
